name: Black Canary
summary: One codename, two women, and a scream that shatters glass. Dinah Drake and her daughter Dinah Laurel Lance have both fought as Black Canary, with the Justice Society, the Justice League and the Birds of Prey.
origin: Black Canary is two women sharing one name, and both of them can take you apart without powers. Robert Kanigher and Carmine Infantino introduced her in Flash Comics #86 in 1947 as a guest in Johnny Thunder's strip, a crime-fighter who posed as a crook to bust gangs. She soon joined the Justice Society, which makes her one of DC's earliest heroines. In 1969 she joined the Justice League and gained a sonic scream, and later stories explained that this Canary was Dinah Laurel Lance, the original Dinah Drake's daughter. Martial artist, tactician and field leader, she has also anchored Birds of Prey, and her romance with Green Arrow is one of comics' great love stories.
powers: Elite martial artist and stick fighter

storyline.title: Johnny Thunder's backup
storyline.beat: Dinah Drake debuts as a crime-fighter who poses as a criminal to break up gangs, appearing in Johnny Thunder's feature, and soon joins the Justice Society.

storyline.title: A new power
storyline.beat: Black Canary joins the Justice League and gains her sonic scream. Later stories explain this Canary is Dinah Laurel Lance, the daughter of the original.

storyline.title: Seattle
storyline.beat: Moving to Seattle with Green Arrow, Dinah is captured and tortured by drug dealers in Mike Grell's gritty miniseries.

storyline.title: Partnering with Oracle
storyline.beat: Dinah becomes Oracle's main field agent in the Birds of Prey, one of DC's longest-running team books.

storyline.title: Married to Ollie
storyline.beat: After decades of on-and-off romance, Dinah marries Green Arrow.

storyline.title: Band on the run
storyline.beat: A new solo series has Dinah touring as the lead singer of a rock band while fighting off attacks.

gossip.text: Black Canary always had her sonic scream.
gossip.truth: She had no powers at first. The scream arrived in 1969.

gossip.text: Two women have been the classic Black Canary: Dinah Drake and her daughter, Dinah Laurel Lance.
She first appeared as a supporting player in a Johnny Thunder story, not her own feature.
For her first 22 years in print she had no powers at all, just judo, a motorbike and a cover job at a flower shop.
Her long romance with Green Arrow is one of DC's most famous couples.

quiz.q: What is Black Canary's signature power?
Who is Black Canary's longtime love?

theme.tagline: Sings for the band, screams for the bad guys.

timeline.title: Flash Comics #86
timeline.note: Dinah Drake debuts in a Johnny Thunder story, posing as a crook to take down crooks.

timeline.title: Justice Society member
timeline.note: Dinah becomes a full member of the Golden Age Justice Society in All Star Comics.

timeline.title: Canary cry
timeline.note: Black Canary moves to Earth-One and joins the Justice League, soon showing off her sonic scream.

timeline.title: The Longbow Hunters
timeline.note: Mike Grell's prestige series puts Dinah through a brutal ordeal that costs her the canary cry.

timeline.title: Birds of Prey
timeline.note: Oracle taps Dinah as her field agent in a one-shot that grows into a long-running series.

timeline.title: Smallville siren
timeline.note: Alaina Huffman brings Black Canary to Smallville as a sonic-screaming vigilante tangled up with Green Arrow.

timeline.title: Birds of Prey film
timeline.note: Jurnee Smollett plays a singing, scrapping Dinah alongside Harley in the Birds of Prey movie.
